name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 10" Dual Mount 3-Level Workstation Sink with Waterfall Faucet and Glass Rinser
shortDescription: In-store Retailers Elevate your kitchen with the MultiSINK Workstation a sculpted centerpiece built for beauty and performance. Its 3-level design and 10" deep basin create seamless zones for prep, rinse, and cleanup. The stainless steel pivoting waterfall faucet offers three spray modes Boost Blade, aerated flow, and rinse while the integrated glass washer keeps drinkware spotless. A double-sided bamboo cutting board, stainless steel colander, and four heavy-duty roll-up grids adapt to your workflow. Two removable drying grilles sit elegantly on the deck, adding utility without clutter. With dual-mount flexibility, cUPC certification, and precision-crafted corners, MultiSINK blends timeless design with everyday efficiency.
